proposal.title: Two-musician livestream with isolated mic recordings
proposal.brief: Livestream a camera performance by two musicians while saving two separate, isolated microphone audio files. Reuse the owned Sony ZV-E10 camera, iPad Air 5 and Sony MDR-7506 headphones. Keep total spending on new equipment strictly below $600 USD.
proposal.explanation: Preserves the existing budget, two-track goal and owned-equipment requirements. This is a goal proposal; physical feasibility is checked separately by deterministic rules.
assumptions: Two microphone sources, provisionally one per musician, are inferred from the isolated-file request; two musicians alone does not establish microphone count.
The two isolated files should be recorded during the livestream, rather than extracted from a combined mix afterward.
needsClarification: Which livestream platform will you use, and must the iPad handle both streaming and recording?
Do you already own microphones, and is one microphone per musician the intended arrangement?

proposal.title: Two-Musician Livestream and Multitrack Setup
proposal.brief: Help two musicians livestream a camera performance and record two isolated microphone tracks, reusing an existing camera, iPad, and headphones within a $600 budget.
proposal.explanation: This proposal targets capturing two isolated audio tracks alongside camera video streaming using existing gear and up to $600 in new equipment. Note that physical feasibility, interface connectivity, and power/cable routing are evaluated separately by deterministic validation rules rather than this proposal.
assumptions: The presence of two musicians is assumed to require two dedicated microphone channels.
The existing iPad and camera possess the requisite ports or software support for simultaneous multitrack recording and livestream routing.
Existing headphones can be driven by or shared via the chosen audio routing setup without exceeding the budget.
needsClarification: Will both musicians perform vocal parts requiring two microphones, or will instruments require direct inputs or specific pickup patterns?
Does the livestreaming platform run directly from the iPad or via an external streaming host?

evaluation: Two live integration probes, not a held-out accuracy benchmark.
